recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the applied Jira decision in active build inputs while preserving PractitionerRole role-specific semantics; subsequent publication tooling can regenerate equivalent diagram output if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-41524 asked PA to fix Person-family communication language wording because the old ISO-639-1 alpha-2 definition conflicted with the broader all-languages/BCP-47 binding and sign-language support; the Applied resolution listed Patient, Person, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and PractitionerRole.
initial_application: Commit f818fedafb4a0c3f32d1ac80ce251ad583425279 applied the approved wording to Patient.communication.language, Person.communication.language, Practitioner.communication.language, and RelatedPerson.communication.language. It did not touch PractitionerRole because current source has PractitionerRole.communication as a direct CodeableConcept, and it left active ParticipantLiving pattern/support artifacts with the stale wording.
additional_context: fhir.ini confirms the affected resources and participantliving logical pattern are active. Zulip confirms the problem was a definition/binding mismatch and records the implementer observation that PractitionerRole lacks the nested communication.language shape. Confluence minutes did not reveal contrary guidance.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that updates PractitionerRole.communication comment, ParticipantLiving.communication definition/comment, Patient/RelatedPerson ParticipantLiving mapping-exception expectations, and stale Patient/RelatedPerson SVG titles that still displayed the old alpha-2-only definition.
source_changes: source/practitionerrole/structuredefinition-PractitionerRole.xml: replaced the stale aa-BB locale comment on PractitionerRole.communication with the approved broader language-tag wording while preserving role-specific guidance.
source/participantliving/participantliving-spreadsheet.xml: updated the active ParticipantLiving.communication pattern definition/comment to avoid ISO-639-1 alpha-2-only wording.
source/patient/patient-participantliving-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated ParticipantLiving pattern expectations for Patient.communication after the pattern definition/comment change.

source/relatedperson/relatedperson-participantliving-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated ParticipantLiving pattern expectations for RelatedPerson.communication after the pattern definition/comment change.
source/patient/patient.svg: updated the checked-in diagram title for Patient.communication.language so it no longer shows the obsolete alpha-2-only definition.
source/relatedperson/relatedperson.svg: updated the checked-in diagram title for RelatedPerson.communication.language so it no longer shows the obsolete alpha-2-only definition.

related_jiras.note: Its implementation introduced the current PractitionerRole.communication CodeableConcept shape, explaining why FHIR-41524 had to be applied to PractitionerRole.communication rather than a nonexistent .communication.language child.
